note: Registry of third-party organizations JVTO refers to. The @id base is the JVTO domain on purpose: the @id identifies *JVTO's reference to* the entity, not the entity itself. Ownership is asserted through sameAs. Never add a sameAs URL without verifying it — leave it empty and mark evidenceStatus 'candidate' instead. A node with an @id and no sameAs is still far better than an anonymous node, because the @id is what consolidates the entity across pages. A description field was added 2026-08-19 for records where jvto-web externalEntities.ts had one (hpwki, bbksda-jatim) — leave absent elsewhere rather than fabricating.

Publisher of articles d-5262697 and d-5492690. No sameAs in the repo. Owner to supply the official site and, if one exists, the Wikidata entry — do not guess a Q-ID. Wikidata Q12481355 verified 2026-08-19: label "detik.com", description "online news and article website based in Indonesia", inception 1998, owned by Trans Corp — matches this org exactly.

Publisher of the Polpar formation article. No sameAs in the repo. Owner to confirm whether the canonical entity is Radar Jember or its parent Jawa Pos before adding one. No standalone Wikidata entry found for Radar Jember as of 2026-08-19 (search only surfaced Radar Bandung, a different Jawa Pos Group title) — left unassigned rather than guessed. Official site verified live.

Publisher of Stefan Loose Reiseführer Indonesien. No sameAs in the repo. A German publisher of this size likely has a Wikidata entry — owner to verify rather than guess. Wikidata Q1262296 ("DuMont Buchverlag") checked 2026-08-19 and rejected: it is the parent general-book publisher (Cologne, est. 1956), a distinct entity from DuMont Reiseverlag (the travel-guide imprint, absorbed into MairDumont in 2004) that published the Stefan Loose guide. Left Wikidata unassigned per the no-guessing rule; official DuMont Reise site used instead. jvto-web/src/lib/schemas/externalEntities.ts independently used https://www.mairdumont.com as its sameAs (2026-08-19 reconciliation) — added alongside rather than replacing dumontreise.de, since both are legitimate URLs for the same publisher (mairdumont.com is the parent corporate site, dumontreise.de is the consumer-facing DuMont Reise brand site) and neither is wrong.

records.canonicalName: Balai Besar KSDA Jawa Timur (BBKSDA Jawa Timur)
records.sourceNote: Regulator of TWA Ijen and issuer of SE.1658/KSA.9/2024, the regulation behind the mandatory health screening. It existed only as a fragment of the string 'HPWKI — supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur' and had no node of its own, despite being JVTO's most load-bearing authority asset. No sameAs in the repo yet. Defined on /verify-jvto/legal rather than the health-screening page: it is reached only through HPWKI's regulator relation, and defining it on a page that never names it left a dangling @id. No Wikidata entry found for this regional conservation unit as of 2026-08-19 (a technical implementation unit under Ditjen KSDAE, not independently notable) — left unassigned rather than guessed. Official site verified live, matches URL already used elsewhere in this repo (buildVerifySchemas.ts references).
